violations.text: Firm is cooling packaged sushi in the sushi display case. Sushi display case is inadequate for cooling. Per person in charge, sushi was made about an hour prior to inspection. Sushi was relocated to the freezer and cooled down to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below during time of inspection. Cooling in the freezer must be implemented immediately. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. English Responding to Vomiting and Diarrhea Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2024
